correctness.rationale: The feasible set of symmetric nonnegative row-stochastic edge/self-loop kernels is convex/compact. Coordinate-permutation averaging preserves the norm SLEM. Invariant kernels have coordinate spectral shifts z_i=n_i a_i and eigenvalues 1-sum_{i∈S}z_i on every nonconstant subset mode, with budget sum c_i z_i≤1. Hence SLEM t obeys t≥(d-1)/(d+1) and t≥1-1/C. Choosing z_i=u=min(2/(d+1),1/C) attains both bounds and is the unique invariant minimizer by saturation. For any unrestricted optimum, each conjugate is optimal and averaging Rayleigh quotients on the one-coordinate centered eigenspaces U_i forces equality with the spectral upper bound µI-P≥0 on 1-perp. Therefore P acts as (1-u)I on EVERY U_i, fixing each complete-graph fiber Laplacian to u(I-J/n_i), all off-diagonal probabilities u/n_i, and the common diagonal 1-Cu. Positive holding iff Σ1/n_i>(d-1)/2; Egyptian fraction classification for d=3 gives (2,3,6),(2,4,4),(3,3,3). Independent finite LPs over all nonconstant subset modes and direct eigenvalue checks support the formulas; they do not prove unrestricted uniqueness.
